Hi team,

Attached is the proposed offer for Natalia Ortega (Candidate ID: GHA-983). Quick summary below — asking for final comp approval and headcount confirmation so I can send the DocuSign today if we’re aligned: 

- Role: Senior Software Engineer (L4) — Backend
- Proposed base: $170,000/year
- Target bonus: 10% (annual, discretionary)
- Sign-on: $10,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 45,000 RSU units over 4 years (25%/25%/25%/25%) — comp sheet shows 4-yr value at current grant rate
- Start window: week of Nov 15 — flexible by a couple weeks if needed
- Hiring manager: Karthik Iyer
- Budget code: ENG-BASE-2026-09 (please confirm)

Attachments: Offer_Natalia_Ortega_v1.pdf, comp_breakdown_ortega.xlsx, offer_letter_ortega_draft.docx

Notes: Natalia has a competing offer that is slightly higher base but lower equity; she’s asked if we can be competitive on sign-on and early-tenure equity. I calibrated the offer to our standard band for L4 with a modest sign-on to close. If anything needs to move (base/eq/sign-on), call it out and I’ll update the doc.

Thanks — Marissa

Thanks, Marissa — reviewing quickly. A couple of asks from my side before we send: 

1) Can we nudge the target bonus to 12% instead of 10%? Natalia's comp is bonus-heavy at competitor, and a slightly higher annual target is a better retention lever than raising base.
2) Equity: would you consider increasing to 50,000 RSUs (same vesting) or adding an additional cliff-year refresh cadence note? I'm ok with 45k, but 50k will be a stronger signal.
3) Please confirm whether the sign-on is grossed up or net; candidate asked about taxes and timing (payable in first payroll).
4) Headcount: confirm this is counted against Q4 open reqs (ENG-HQ-112). If we need finance signoff, loop in finance.

If increasing bonus to 12% and bumping equity to 50k is a problem from comp pool perspective, I can accept current numbers and we can add a 12-month performance bonus clause. Let me know.

-Karthik
